# Hypertask Documentation

> Hypertask is an AI-native project management tool. This documentation covers the web app, CLI, and MCP integration for AI agents.

## Docs

- [What is Hypertask?](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/introduction/): Overview of the platform, architecture, and key capabilities
- [Quick Start](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/quickstart/): Get up and running in under 5 minutes
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.hypertask.ai/getting-started/concepts/): Projects, sections, tasks, comments, and the data model
- [AI Features](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/ai-features/): Task Writer, Voice Dictation, HyperAI co-worker
- [Boards & Sections](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/boards/): Kanban boards, section management, views
- [Tasks](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/tasks/): Task fields, priorities, relations, subtasks
- [Inbox & Notifications](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/inbox/): Notification system and inbox management
- [Collaboration](https://docs.hypertask.ai/features/collaboration/): Teams, workspaces, mentions, reactions
- [MCP Integration](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/overview/): Connect AI agents via Model Context Protocol
- [Agent Workflows](https://docs.hypertask.ai/mcp/workflows/): Patterns for AI agents working with tasks
- [MCP Tools Reference](https://docs.hypertask.ai/api/tools-reference/): Complete parameter reference for all 15 MCP tools
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.hypertask.ai/cli/reference/): Full command reference for the hypertask CLI
- [Changelog](https://docs.hypertask.ai/changelog/): Daily log of shipped features, fixes, and improvements

## MCP Access

AI agents can connect to Hypertask via MCP to manage tasks programmatically. Connect to `https://mcp.hypertask.ai` with a Bearer token from your Hypertask account settings.

AI agents can also connect to the docs MCP server at `https://hypertask-docs-mcp.valentin-603.workers.dev/mcp` to read and update documentation pages.
